title: RightDerivedBaseChangeSingleUnit
statement: Let B, B′, C, C′ be abelian categories with derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and enough injectives in B and B′. Let G : B → C and G′ : B′ → C′ be additive, and beta : B → B′ and gamma : C → C′ additive exact functors [lem-sp-exact-functor-preserves-homology]. For e : G ⋙ gamma → beta ⋙ G′ and Y in B, let u_G(Y) be rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit from [lem-sbc-right-derived-single-unit-homology-comparison]. Then gamma⁺(u_G(Y)) followed by derived base change on Y[0] and R⁺G′ of the beta single-complex comparison equals the gamma single-complex comparison followed by the single complex of e(Y) and u_G′(beta(Y)). No left exactness of G or G′ is assumed.

proof.text: Evaluate rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_fac at the homotopy single complex K = Y[0]. Expand the auxiliary transformation and use mapHomotopyCategoryPlusCompIso_refl_hom_app and its inverse form to remove the composition comparisons. This is the unit equation before the single-complex comparisons.

The canonical transport singleTransport from Qh of a homotopy single complex to a derived single complex has identity hom: apply the faithful inclusion, expand preimageIso, and use the identity quotientCompQhIso component. Prove single_exact_transport under the faithful inclusion: expand mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app and mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor to identify the exact-functor single comparison with its localization comparison followed by Qh of homotopySingleIso. Expand both rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit terms, use the identity transports, substitute the beta comparison, cancel its localization comparison and its inverse, and use naturality of the G-prime derived unit along homotopySingleIso beta Y.

Prove single_naturality by the faithful inclusion and the Q images of explicit cochain maps. Their equality follows componentwise: in degree zero expand singleMapHomologicalComplex_hom_app_self and single_map_f_self and cancel identities; away from degree zero the final single-complex comparison components vanish. Cancel the G-prime single comparison to rewrite the main equation. Naturality of gamma.mapDerivedCategoryPlusFactorsh along homotopySingleIso G Y, the equality single_comparison, and inverse-hom cancellation identify the remaining prefix with gamma.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor via single_exact_transport. This proves the stated equation without new assumptions.

theorem rightDerivedBaseChange_single_unit (e : G ⋙ γ ⟶ β ⋙ G') (Y : B) :
    γ.mapDerivedCategoryPlus.map (G.rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit Y) ≫
      (rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange e).app
        ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor B 0).obj Y) ≫
      G'.rightDerivedFunctorPlus.map
        ((β.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app Y) =
    (γ.mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app (G.obj Y) ≫
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor C' 0).map (e.app Y) ≫
      G'.rightDerivedPlusSingleUnit (β.obj Y)
